References to helpful resources for canc.Explanation: The ACS Survivorship Center Web site provides comprehensive resources for cancer survivors, which can help the patient manage her ongoing symptoms and improve her quality of life.

Journey Forward offers tools and resources to help cancer survivors create a survivorship care plan, which can be beneficial for the patient in managing her follow-up care and addressing her persistent symptoms.

The ASCO survivor and caregiver site provides valuable information and support for cancer survivors and their caregivers, which can help the patient and her family navigate her ongoing treatment and side effects.

The NCCN patient and caregiver resources offer guidelines and support for managing cancer survivorship, which can help the patient address her low energy levels, appetite issues, and other side effects.
Patient navigation services can help guide the patient through her cancer care continuum, ensuring she receives the necessary support and resources for her ongoing treatment and side effects.
Peer support groups provide empowerment and support to cancer patients, which can help the patient cope with her symptoms and improve her overall well-being.
Referral to a nutritionist can help the patient manage her weight and nutritional needs, addressing her low appetite and weight loss.
The ASCO Guidelines on the screening, assessment, and management of fatigue in adult survivors of cancer can provide valuable information for managing the patient's low energy levels.
Cancer.net offers patient information on managing symptoms, healthy behaviors, and care coordination, which can help the patient address her ongoing side effects and improve her quality of life.
